name: Moli v1.1.18
body:
## What's Changed

### CDP, Navigation & Window

* fix(cdp): let replacement navigation bypass inherited load waits #1509
* fix(cdp): complete Fetch configuration updates during navigation #1582
* refactor(cdp): unify Page access and optional owner lookups #1612
* fix(window): replace cross-origin surface caches with native bindings #1594
* feat(window): expose native BarProp objects and popup visibility #1470
* fix(iframe): retire nested frames in disconnected shadow trees #1518

### Renderer & Lifecycle

* fix(renderer): release retired child content surfaces #1488
* fix(dom): resolve detached nodes in their owning host #1512
* fix(html): retain child parser EOF during script execution #1514
* fix(renderer): reclaim collected child surface cache entries #1549
* fix(renderer): invalidate option styles when select values change #1553
* fix(renderer): construct intersection entries in the callback Realm #1561
* fix(renderer): read prepared intersection callback context directly #1590
* fix(renderer): use native prototypes for browser-created objects by @lanyue-llk in #1585
* fix(renderer): resolve VisualViewport dimensions through its receiver Window #1596
* refactor(renderer): remove legacy print screenshot entry point #1610

### Fetch, XHR & Storage

* fix(xhr): reject ineligible document responses #1468
* fix(fetch): bound authentication retries per logical request #1497
* fix(fetch): bound diagnostics after readiness failures #1616
* feat(fetch): isolate subrequest cancellation and response progress #1275
* fix(storage): always report CDP cookie priority by @jfarcand in #1502

### DOM, Forms & Editing

* fix(forms): inherit text styles without duplicating focus decoration #1442
* fix(forms): resolve placeholder text through its pseudo style #1443
* fix(forms): paint focused text-control selections and carets #1444
* fix(editing): distinguish input and textarea InsertHTML behavior #1494
* fix(dom): derive element creation options before validation #1510
* fix(input): revalidate contenteditable targets after beforeinput #1597

### WebIDL, Events & File API

* fix(webidl): expose UI event attributes on native prototypes #1536
* feat(webidl): add a fixed non-shared BufferSource converter #1573
* refactor(webapi): consolidate declarations and native receiver checks #1583
* fix(events): construct trusted native history event subclasses #1486
* fix(events): preserve KeyboardEvent initialization semantics #1185
* fix(file-api): derive Blob, File and FileList receiver checks #1530
* fix(file-api): bind FileReader prototype handlers with native receivers #1533
* fix(file-api): unify native proxy FileReader event dispatch #1608

### Runtime & Callbacks

* refactor(callbacks): share Window and Worker callback execution #1505
* refactor(callbacks): consolidate execution and binding resolution #1545
* refactor(runtime): share codec and observer registration state #1557

### CSS, Fonts & Layout

* fix(cssom): return independent live computed style declarations #1449
* fix(layout): resolve intrinsic width constraints in shared sizing #1441
* perf(layout): avoid redundant box moves and inline style conversion #1492
* perf(layout): accumulate visual cluster positions in one pass #1434
* refactor(layout): consume Parley's positioned visual clusters #1599
* perf(layout): reuse prepared context for anonymous styles #1611
* perf(layout): remove per-style anonymous provenance #1613
* fix(fonts): accept legacy variable font format hints by @arjendevos in #1562
* feat(css): expose CSSAnimation and CSSTransition interface objects #1041

### Canvas, SVG & Paint

* feat(paint): preserve path winding rules in native snapshots #1475
* fix(canvas): preserve signed pixel rectangles through clipping #1471
* fix(svg): validate filter property receivers and reflect windowless values #1526
* fix(svg): implement filter setStdDeviation methods #1363
* fix(svg): reflect native animated integer filter attributes #1207
* fix(paint): cover large repeated raster backgrounds #1566

### Performance, Observers & Web APIs

* feat(performance): share native User Timing and observers with workers #1484
* feat(performance): expose the remaining timing interface objects #1040
* fix(performance): assign entry navigation identities #1528
* fix(performance): retain ordered worker event handlers #1541
* fix(intersection-observer): throw DOM syntax errors for invalid margins #1511
* fix(permissions): give PermissionStatus inherited EventTarget behavior by @lanyue-llk in #1587

### WebRTC, Media, Crypto & Payment

* feat(payment): implement native payment update event values #1472
* feat(crypto): add opaque self-signed certificate primitives #1450
* fix(webrtc): preserve RTCError stacks and native proxy slots #1451
* fix(webrtc): snapshot and validate peer connection configuration #1508
* feat(webrtc): expose non-constructible transport and RTP interfaces #1049
* feat(media): expose MediaSource handle and buffer interface shells #1051

### Security & Dependencies

* fix(deps): update vulnerable Rust dependencies #1458
* fix(trusted-types): preserve policy DOMString code units #1506
* fix(trusted-types): avoid duplicate reports for transformed trusted scripts #1457

### WPT, Testing & Documentation

* chore(wpt): refresh release case statuses and fix version probe #1455
* fix(wpt): compute IDL lengths across overloads and variadic arguments #1448
* test(svg): cover extreme number and transform serialization #1464
* test(workers): verify JSON and CSS module response MIME validation #1480
* fix(renderer): tolerate fill metadata in form tests by @lanyue-llk in #1500
* test(scripts): synchronize async chunk fixture on execution #1550
* test(protocol): run timer navigation setup on its local lane #1551
* test(indexeddb): isolate temporary directories across test processes by @lanyue-llk in #1589
* test(runtime): release replacement gate before asserting reservation #1552
* docs: add Korean README translation by @kyoungbinkim in #1581

## New Contributors

* @jfarcand made their first contribution in #1502
* @kyoungbinkim made their first contribution in #1581
* @arjendevos made their first contribution in #1562

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/lexmount/moli/compare/v1.1.17...v1.1.18

name: Moli v1.1.17
body:
## What's Changed

### PDF & Paint

* feat(pdf): render searchable PDFs #1435
* feat(pdf): preserve hyperlinks and verify native rendering in CI #1437
* fix(paint): restore Muse pill corners and SVG colors #1438

### Fetch, XHR & Encoding

* feat(encoding): add a native streaming XHR response decoder #1277
* fix(fetch): preserve received HTTP status text #1347
* fix(fetch): retain referrer selection across redirect hops #1367
* fix(fetch): resolve service worker referrer metadata #1409
* fix(fetch): reject Office documents as raw downloads by @lanyue-llk in #1433
* fix(runtime): preserve typed fetch timeout for late inner results #1394

### Window, Frames & Navigation

* fix(window): avoid replaying completed auxiliary document lifecycle #1314
* fix(window): queue initial javascript URLs on the target page #1317
* fix(window): resolve parent targets from the receiver #1396
* fix(iframe): dispatch one initial load for adopted frames #1324
* fix(iframe): centralize document load delivery #1404
* fix(browser): preserve permission replies when page owners retire #1393
* refactor(browser): preserve typed permission and download errors #1405
* fix(runtime): defer child-frame evaluation through the Inspector owner #1399

### WebIDL & Native Bindings

* feat(webidl): derive wrapping signed long long conversion #1401
* feat(webidl): derive sequences of dictionary values #1402
* feat(webidl): write BufferSource rows without changing padding #1403
* feat(webidl): derive octet arguments with modulo-256 conversion #1353
* feat(webidl): derive EnforceRange unsigned short conversion #1421
* feat(webidl): support lossless DOMString16 in derive bindings #1422
* fix(webidl): isolate internal descriptor records from prototype pollution #1423

### DOM, HTML & Editing

* fix(dom): expose the native SVG document root #1261
* fix(dom): preserve DOMImplementation argument and result realms #1378
* fix(dom): serialize outerHTML by document mode #1411
* fix(domparser): retain HTML document parse modes #1414
* fix(editing): support InsertHTML in text controls #1415
* fix(input): align click targets and release order with Chromium #1430

### CSSOM, Stylesheets & Layout

* fix(cssom): derive computed-style arguments and handle disconnected elements #1362
* fix(cssom): validate keyframe receivers and preserve mutation errors #1400
* fix(stylesheets): honor quirks mode MIME compatibility #1412
* fix(layout): apply 2D transforms written with 3D functions #1398
* fix(layout): paint option labels in native select listboxes #1406

### SVG

* fix(svg): validate accessor brands and preserve producer realm identity #1342
* fix(svg): enforce float distance conversion and empty-path errors #1417
* fix(svg): apply computed fill-rule to geometric containment #1418

### Streams, Events & Workers

* fix(streams): mark internal rejections handled without author catch hooks #1392
* fix(streams): validate WritableStream receivers through native brands #1419
* fix(events): preserve PromiseRejectionEvent object identity #1395
* fix(worker): omit the error value when reporting nested worker failures #1365
* refactor(worker): box dedicated worker message payloads #1397

### URL

* fix(url): preserve file URL hosts and leading path segments #1344

### Web Platform APIs

* feat(speech): construct native synthesis events with validated payloads #1171
* refactor(webaudio): derive AudioNode graph argument validation #1352
* feat(webauthn): parse JSON credential options with native WebIDL conversion #1425
* feat(credentials): bind native CredentialsContainer entry points #1426
* feat(media): bind native PictureInPicture event payloads #1420

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/lexmount/moli/compare/v1.1.16...v1.1.17

name: Moli v1.1.16
body:
## What's Changed

### Fetch, XHR & Cookies

* feat(fetch): add curl-compatible HTTP failure flags #1331
* fix(fetch): cancel raw downloads for unsupported output #1374
* feat(fetch): allow explicit interaction before page dump by @lanyue-llk in #1305
* feat(fetch): retain explicit referrer state independently of request identity #1366
* fix(xhr): preserve upload-listener preflight requirements #1162
* fix(xhr): reject open in retired child document realms #1328
* fix(cookies): handle Unicode expiration dates without panicking #1390

### Navigation, Window & Renderer

* fix(renderer): dispatch form navigation events to target window #1173
* fix(navigation): retain ignored response metadata on the terminal gate #1203
* fix(history): give initial auxiliary documents one history entry #1310
* fix(window): synchronize Location when reusing the initial Document #1319
* fix(csp): check the initiator before javascript URL navigation #1323
* fix(renderer): tie Web API roots and Window cleanup to realm lifetime #1330
* fix(dom): resolve foreign reflectors in their owning page #1316
* fix(window): retain the name of closed auxiliary windows #1312
* fix(window): share inherited document.domain across related pages #1318
* fix(webdriver): stop sync alert during page load from hanging the session by @LeandroPG19 in #1333

### Accessibility

* fix(accessibility): restore Puppeteer ARIA selectors #1304
* fix(accessibility): build composed AX trees lazily from computed styles #1325
* fix(accessibility): include descendant text alternatives in control names #1377
* fix(accessibility): preserve NBSP in accessible names #1386
* perf(accessibility): reduce semantic dump memory with compact AX storage #1388
* fix(dom): honor computed content visibility in innerText #1387

### WebIDL, DOM & Runtime

* feat(webidl): derive dictionary member order and inheritance #1268
* feat(webidl): add unrestricted binary32 float conversion #1281
* feat(webidl): support EnforceRange signed long long #1244
* feat(webidl): retain native BufferSource identity through conversion #1286
* fix(webidl): expose readonly ResizeObserver result snapshots #881
* feat(dom): add lossless native DOM string values #1273
* fix(abort): release native roots after signal termination #1263
* fix(runtime): unify output publication and Runtime state delivery #1248
* refactor(runtime): calculate wait deadlines from an explicit clock #1259
* refactor(performance): use generated native receiver checks #1222
* refactor: prepare stable source for newer Rust diagnostics #1256
* fix(renderer): remove exports of deleted Node helpers #1311

### Forms, File API & URL

* feat(file-api): snapshot blob URL objects with creator access keys #1249
* feat(forms): distinguish button Auto state in the core #1240
* feat(forms): model input value attribute modes in the core #1239
* feat(url): compare and restore native origin values #1242
* feat(url): classify about srcdoc URLs precisely #1241

### Canvas, Geometry & SVG

* fix(canvas): expose native transform snapshots #1265
* fix(canvas): apply transforms and native conversion to fillRect #1280
* feat(canvas): expose ImageBitmapRenderingContext interface #1052
* fix(geometry): preserve point dictionary conversion order #1260
* fix(geometry): return branded DOMRectList objects #576
* feat(svg): expose native value and element interfaces #276
* fix(svg): validate native geometry method receivers #1279
* fix(svg): retain computed path coordinates in native geometry #1294
* fix(svg): reject invalid length mutations before changing state #1209
* fix(svg): preserve distance paths for shapes with one zero axis #1266
* feat(svg): honor fill rules and reject nonfinite fill points #1233
* feat(svg): retain transform functions and rotation centers #1232
* feat(svg): expose point-list parsing with incomplete-pair handling #1212
* fix(svg): resolve detached font lengths with initial style #1349

### CSS, Fonts & Observers

* fix(observers): parse margin defaults from CSS tokens #1272
* fix(performance): validate observer options and retain observe mode #1264
* fix(fonts): validate binary FontFace data after descriptor conversion #1208
* fix(fonts): settle document fonts ready after loading and layout invalidation #1329
* feat(cssom): expose missing properties with CSS-wide keywords #1063
* fix(cssom): convert declaration values before mutation #1345

### IndexedDB

* fix(indexeddb): protect native key range bounds and receivers #1278
* fix(indexeddb): validate native schema key paths before mutation #1293
* feat(indexeddb): add native UTF-16 name values #1276
* fix(indexeddb): preserve first primary keys in reverse unique cursors #1340

### Web Platform APIs

* feat(events): expose missing native Window and DOM handlers #997
* feat(webrtc): implement native RTCError and RTCErrorEvent #1061
* feat(webrtc): construct ICE error events with native fields #1062
* feat(webaudio): unify native AudioNode interfaces #1010
* feat(audio): expose AudioListener and AudioParamMap interface shells #1055
* feat(gamepad): expose native interfaces and event payloads #1008
* feat(webcodecs): add native video codec capability queries #1168
* feat(credentials): expose native members and authenticator capability queries #1199
* feat(credentials): expose the secure CredentialsContainer interface #1037
* feat(webtransport): expose secure owned stream interface objects #1068
* feat(media): expose secure encrypted-media owner interfaces #1050
* feat(locks): expose secure Lock and LockManager interfaces #1039
* feat(reporting): expose the native ReportBody interface object #1067

### XML & Encoding

* fix(xml): validate numeric references using the XML Char production #1339
* refactor(encoding): rename shared document streaming decoder #1332

### Testing, Build & CI

* test(gamepad): use the default runtime context by @lanyue-llk in #1343
* test(webauthn): use the default runtime context #1351
* test(webauthn): use the default runtime context #1370
* test(canvas): use the default runtime context by @lanyue-llk in #1375
* test: stabilize navigation, layout and HTTP fixtures by @lanyue-llk in #1385
* chore(wpt): refresh full release case status lists #1391
* ci: use TUNA apt mirrors in all dependency installation jobs #1326

## New Contributors

* @LeandroPG19 made their first contribution in #1333

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/lexmount/moli/compare/v1.1.15...v1.1.16
